summary: A clerk gives {order} a filing date distinct from the board's vote date.
realLife: The 2025 apartment order passed five to four on June 30. The board's explanatory statement records filing with the city clerk on July 1.
gates: The case record identifies the adopted motion, vote date and filing receipt.
inGame: needs: adopted motion, vote date and filing receipt.

turns.what: The public record carries both dates.
The account can report adoption while leaving filing open.
